About our brand and products
LIVIVA modernizes pantry staples with differentiated pasta and rice alternatives designed for familiar everyday meals. Our portfolio includes high-protein pasta, dried shirataki pasta and rice, and new gluten-free high-protein innovations. Across the line, LIVIVA is built around the shopper demand for protein-forward, lower-carb, gluten-free, and convenient meal solutions. Recent internal brand notes also position LIVIVA around high-protein, low-carb pasta growth and highlight new gluten-free high-protein pasta innovation.

What makes us different

  • Modern pantry staples in differentiated formats
  • High-Protein Pasta with 27 g protein per 45 g dry serving
  • Lower-carb positioning across key items
  • Dried shirataki format that is lighter, easier to handle, and shelf-stable
  • Familiar meal occasions: pasta, noodles, and rice alternatives
  • Quick prep and everyday usability
  • Strong better-for-you shelf story with protein and low-carb relevance

How affiliates can earn
Affiliates earn by sharing LIVIVA with audiences looking for better-for-you pantry staples and driving purchases through their unique affiliate links or codes. The strongest conversion angles are likely to be:

  • High protein
  • Lower carb
  • Gluten-free options
  • Fast prep
  • Pantry-friendly convenience
  • Innovative alternatives to traditional pasta and rice

How to promote us
Best content angles for affiliates:

  • Everyday meal swaps using LIVIVA pasta or rice
  • High-protein meal ideas
  • Lower-carb weeknight dinners
  • Gluten-free pantry finds
  • Quick lunch and dinner recipes
  • Product comparison content showing LIVIVA’s differentiated dry format and convenience
  • Taste, texture, and easy recipe demonstrations

Recommended creator talking points:

  • High-Protein Pasta delivers 27 g protein per 45 g dry serving
  • Fast cooking and easy meal prep
  • Familiar pasta and rice occasions in more modern formats
  • Shelf-stable and pantry friendly
  • Strong fit for shoppers looking for protein-forward and lower-carb options

Welcome to the LIVIVA Affiliate Program!


We’re excited to have you join us. LIVIVA was created to modernize pantry staples with innovative, better-for-you products designed for everyday meals. As an affiliate, you’ll share LIVIVA with your audience, earn from every qualifying order through your unique link or code, and help us bring more thoughtful food choices to more households.


About Our Brand and Products


LIVIVA modernizes pantry staples with differentiated pasta and rice alternatives designed for familiar everyday meals. Our product line includes high-protein pasta, dried shirataki pasta and rice, and other innovative pantry staples created for today’s shopper. Depending on the item, LIVIVA supports lower-carb, protein-forward, gluten-free, and healthy shopper preferences, while staying convenient, shelf-stable, and easy to enjoy.


What Makes LIVIVA Different


  • Modern pantry staples in differentiated formats
  • High-Protein Pasta with 27 g protein per 45 g dry serving
  • Lower-carb options across key products
  • Shelf-stable, pantry-friendly convenience
  • Quick and easy meal preparation
  • Familiar meal occasions like pasta, noodles, and rice in more innovative formats
  • Better-for-you products designed for today’s shoppers


How Affiliates Can Earn


Affiliates earn $12 per qualifying order through their unique affiliate link or discount code. It’s a simple way to share products you love while earning on every completed order you help generate.


How to Promote LIVIVA


We welcome content that feels authentic to you and your audience. Great ways to promote LIVIVA include:


  • Everyday meal ideas
  • Recipe content
  • Pantry staples roundups
  • Better-for-you grocery recommendations
  • High-protein meal inspiration
  • Lower-carb meal swaps
  • Quick lunch or dinner ideas
  • Social posts, blog features, and email content

Please keep all product messaging accurate and use product-specific benefits where applicable.


Who Can Join


Anyone who is passionate about sharing better-for-you food, everyday meal ideas, pantry staples, and thoughtful grocery finds is welcome to join. Whether you’re a creator, influencer, blogger, recipe developer, or simply someone who loves introducing your community to products you genuinely enjoy, we’d be excited to partner with you.


Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions


By joining the LIVIVA Affiliate Program, you agree to the following:


Eligibility


The program is open to creators, influencers, bloggers, and other partners who promote LIVIVA in a professional and brand-appropriate way.


Commission


Affiliates earn $12 per qualifying order made through their unique affiliate link or discount code.


Qualifying Orders


A qualifying order is a completed purchase that is tracked through your unique link or code, paid in full, and not canceled, refunded, returned, or flagged as fraudulent.


Payments


Commission payments are issued according to the affiliate platform’s payment schedule and only for qualifying orders.


Promotion Guidelines


Affiliates may promote LIVIVA through approved channels such as social media, blogs, email, and other owned platforms. Content must be accurate, respectful, and aligned with LIVIVA brand standards.


Claims and Compliance


Affiliates may not make false, misleading, or unapproved claims about LIVIVA products. Please avoid medical or disease-related claims and describe products accurately using product-specific benefits where applicable.


Brand Use


LIVIVA logos, images, and product information may only be used to promote LIVIVA and may not be changed in a misleading way.


Program Rights


LIVIVA may update these terms, pause the program, or remove affiliates from the program at any time.
